provenance.notes: Reference translations are from rileykim/multilingual-document; quality is ml-curated (not certified-translator). Treat as v0.1.4 expansion data.

regions.text: The most important item in this context is a database on agrochemicals per country, use,pending, as well as full registration. This project is currently under development. Theunderlying reason for these efforts is the role the ADl's (Acceptable Daily Intake) play inregulatory MRL's. This target has been approached by several avenues: (a) the amount ofagrochemicals sold (SIGMA database); (b) the extent of usage by farmers - an inquiry byUNITAB showed a distinct change of the usage pattern, and a surprisingly low number ofCPAs that are really in use; (c) a summary of the currently available toxicological reviews(I.T.I.C.).

references.en-ru: 在此背景下，最重要的项目是一个关于各国农用化学品使用、待定以及完全注册情况的数据库。该项目目前正在开发中。这些努力背后的原因是ADI（每日允许摄入量）在监管MRLs（最大残留限量）中所起的作用。这一目标已经通过几个途径来实现：(a) 农用化学品销售量（SIGMA数据库）；(b) 农民使用的程度——UNITAB的一项调查显示使用模式有明显变化，实际使用的CPA数量出奇地少；(c) 目前可获得的毒理学评估摘要（I.T.I.C.）。

regions.text: A well-thought certification procedure was seen by ACAC as the most important topic ofthis chapter. Basic principles leading to a meaningful certification are: (a) use of labeled andregistered agrochemicals only; (b) effective communication to local growers' associations orgroups; (c) possibility to targeting the activities at growers' level, and (d) invoking thesupport of tobacco dealers.

references.en-ru: 一个经过深思熟虑的认证程序被ACAC视为本章最重要的议题。实现有意义认证的基本原则包括：(a) 仅使用标签和注册过的农用化学品；(b) 与当地种植者协会或团体进行有效沟通；(c) 有可能在种植者层面开展活动；以及 (d) 获得烟草商的支持。

regions.text: An informational booklet was handed out to Argentinean tobacco farmers that showed in acolorful and easily understandable way the "do's" and "don't do's". It could serve as atemplate for similar booklets for other markets (Eastern Europe, Turkey). A cooperationwith the CORESTA Sub-Group on Good Agricultural Practice would have merits in thiscontext.

references.en-ru: 向阿根廷烟农分发了一本信息手册，以彩色且易于理解的方式展示了“应该做”和“不应该做”的事项。这可以作为为其他市场（东欧、土耳其）类似手册的模板。在这方面，与CORESTA良好农业实践小组的合作将具有价值。

regions.text: The most important issue in this context is a worldwide list of regulatory MRL's fortobacco. Such draft lists exist for some countries. However, due to the rapid development inthis sector, these lists are never exhaustive.

references.en-ru: 在此背景下，最重要的问题是全球范围内的烟草监管最大残留限量（MRL）清单。一些国家已经存在这样的草案清单。然而，由于该领域的快速发展，这些清单从来都不是全面的。

regions.text: A discussion was held on the scientific meaning of MRL's since these numbers ratherbelong to a political category, though with some scientific background. Their counterpart inreality would be residues resulting from usage of agrochemicals according to GAP, thelatter being coined "GRL's" (Guidance Residue Limits).

references.en-ru: 就MRLs的科学意义进行了讨论，因为这些数值更多地属于政治范畴，尽管有一定的科学背景。它们在现实中的对应物是根据良好农业规范（GAP）使用农药后产生的残留物，后者被称为“GRLs”（指导残留限量）。

regions.text: ACAC has taken over the responsibility to overlook the situation dealing with GMtobaccos. The target of the committee is to get a worldwide overview over the recentdevelopments. ACAC will continue to keep CORESTA abreast of the latest developmentsin this field. The ACAC supports the development of quantitative methods for GMOdetection and determination by a specific Task Force.

references.en-ru: ACAC已经接管了处理GM烟草情况的责任。委员会的目标是全面了解最近的发展情况。ACAC将继续让CORESTA了解该领域的最新进展。ACAC支持通过一个特别工作组开发用于检测和确定转基因生物的定量方法。

regions.text: Report of the Committee on Human Smoking Behaviour

references.en-ru: 人类吸烟行为委员会报告

regions.text: Richard BAKER, Chairman of the Committee, reported on the progress of this Committee,which has nearly completed its work: the review on Compensation has been published in ascientific jourmal at the end of 1999, and presented as an inter-group paper by GerhardSCHERER at both 1999 Study Group meetings.

references.en-ru: 委员会主席理查德·贝克报告了该委员会的工作进展，其工作已接近完成：关于赔偿的审查已于1999年底在一份科学期刊上发表，并由格哈德·谢勒作为小组间论文在1999年的两次研究小组会议上进行了介绍。

regions.text: The review on vent blocking has been completed and is presently being submitted forpublication in a scientific journal.

references.en-ru: 关于通风口堵塞的审查已经完成，目前正在提交给科学期刊发表。
